item.title: How to Adjust Your Balcony Drip System for Hot Weather
item.description: How to Adjust Your Balcony Drip System for Hot Weather The problem: Your drip system worked fine in April. Now it’s late May, your balcony faces south, and your tomatoes look thirsty by 2 PM. You bump the timer to run longer — and two weeks later you’ve got fungus gnats and yellow lower leaves. Hot weather changes the physics of container watering. Small pots dry out faster, but they also saturate faster.
